axis: K / IT9 P6 case: the HIF axis in the glycolytic shift (Q2)

mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: A mechanism experiment about whether the HIF-dependent part of the glycolytic shift is adaptive or harmful: partial benefit at best, and only if the shift is harmful. Not deep recovery. Track B: none.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery

candidate.name: HIF axis lowering (genetic HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown; PX-478-class lever) in the glycolytic shift, with a prolyl-hydroxylase 'mimic' as the direction control: a mechanism experiment, not a treatment

disease_assertions.target_id: HIF-1alpha protein and HIF target genes
disease_assertions.endpoint: HIF-1alpha protein (normoxia) and HIF target transcripts; glucose uptake after HIF1A knockdown
disease_assertions.source: PMID 25012504 (Abu-Remaileh 2014): Wwox-null mouse embryonic fibroblasts, MCF7 WWOX knockdown, brown fat and muscle of Wwox-null mice; NOT a neural cell type
disease_assertions.locator: disease-models/wwox/research/deepdive_manifests/PMID25012504.json; needs.json NEED-PDH-PYRUVATE-AXIS observation O1; case record section 2

context.disease_id: Wwox-null mouse cells and tissues (non-neural, proliferative)
context.cell_type: embryonic fibroblast; MCF7; brown fat; muscle

disease_assertions.measured_result_note: HIF-1alpha protein is readily detected in the NUCLEI of knockout MEFs in normoxia and barely in wild type (qualitative nuclear-fraction detection), with less hydroxylation; HIF targets are higher; HIF1A knockdown rescues glucose uptake in the knockout MEFs; the difference disappears under hypoxia. HIF1A mRNA is comparable in skeletal muscle of knockout and wild-type mice (the paper's statement is for muscle, not MEFs). In knockout mice digoxin RAISES blood glucose (reversing their low glucose) and lowers GLUT1 and PHD3 expression. No neural cell type was examined.

disease_assertions.target_id: EPAS1, HK2, SLC2A1, ARNT, HIF1A transcripts
disease_assertions.endpoint: ratio of normalised counts, knockout over wild type
disease_assertions.source: GSE156243, the deposit of the 2021 organoid paper (PMID 34268881); descriptive extraction in the IT9 P4c-e package (organoid_target_gene_rows.tsv); not an evaluation by reversal of any gene set

context.disease_id: WWOX-deficient human cerebral organoid model (engineered knockout; NOT a patient allele)
context.genotype: WWOX knockout versus wild type (4 versus 2 libraries, one laboratory)

disease_assertions.measured_result_note: EPAS1 3.80 times, HK2 4.73 times, SLC2A1 2.67 times, ARNT 1.46 times; HIF1A mRNA 0.84 times (flat, as expected for a protein-level axis); PDK1 0.78 times. Four versus two libraries, one laboratory; the glycolytic genes also fall with elapsed culture time in unperturbed spheroids, so composition or maturity can contribute. HK2, SLC2A1 and PDK1 belong to the six-gene IT7 readout (guard IT7_READOUT6): they are observations here and cannot be used to evaluate any compound.

disease_assertions.source: PMID 35328751: human fibroblast line with WWOX sgRNA (the paper calls it knockout and also a downregulation line; non-neural); normoxia or hypoxia by normo- or hyperglycaemia

context.genotype: WWOX sgRNA CRISPR/Cas9 lentivirus versus control

disease_assertions.measured_result_note: Cytoplasmic HIF-1alpha is LOWER in two of four conditions (about two-fold in normoxia with normoglycaemia, p below 0.01, and nearly two-fold in hypoxia with normoglycaemia, p below 0.001; no significant difference is reported for the other two), the nuclear fraction is UNCHANGED (the transcriptionally active pool, the compartment measured in the MEFs), and one blot repetition is shown: the compartments differ from the MEF observation, so this neither confirms nor cleanly contradicts it. Lactate is higher in all four conditions. HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein have never been measured in a WWOX-deficient neural cell.

drug_assertions.target_id: HIF-1alpha protein and HIF target genes (GLUT-1, VEGF)
drug_assertions.endpoint: HIF-1alpha protein, transactivation and target genes after PX-478
drug_assertions.source: PubMed abstracts (Koh 2008, cancer cell lines in normoxia and hypoxia; Welsh 2004, HT-29 colon xenografts); NOT WWOX EVIDENCE

context.disease_id: cancer cell lines and a colon xenograft (not WWOX)
context.species: human cell lines in mouse xenografts

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: PX-478 lowers HIF-1alpha protein and transactivation in cancer lines (reported mechanisms: lower HIF1A mRNA, inhibited translation, less deubiquitination) and lowers HIF-1alpha, VEGF and GLUT-1 in xenografts. BNIP3, HK2, LDHA and LDHB are not reported in the abstracts. No neural datum.

drug_assertions.target_id: behaviour and hippocampal neurons after prenatal hypoxia; body weight and liver enzymes
drug_assertions.endpoint: ASD-like behaviour, necrotic neurons, body weight, ALP and ALT
drug_assertions.source: PubMed abstract of a 2024 rat study of prenatal hypoxia (PX-478 started one or three weeks after birth); NOT WWOX EVIDENCE

context.disease_id: rat prenatal-hypoxia model with ASD-like behaviour (not WWOX)

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: Improved behaviour and fewer hippocampal necrotic neurons are reported, and also lower body weight and raised ALP and ALT after the one-week start: a mixed result, abstract only, one model. Kept as UNKNOWN direction because favourable and unfavourable endpoints are reported together.

drug_assertions.endpoint: any quantitative activity or mechanism annotation
drug_assertions.source: compound-database retrieval, molecule-first, for the PX-478 free-base record and its salt record, 2026-10-30; NOT WWOX EVIDENCE
drug_assertions.measured_result_note: No quantitative activity annotation and no mechanism annotation is held: an ABSENT datum, not a negative. The structure carries a bis(2-chloroethyl)amino N-oxide (nitrogen-mustard alert); only an adult intravenous phase 1 study is registered; no CNS or paediatric datum.

drug_assertions.target_id: HIF stabilisation by prolyl-hydroxylase inhibition (direction control)
drug_assertions.endpoint: EGLN1 inhibition; seizure and secondary-hypothyroidism label statements; thyroid-receptor action reported in a 2025 paper
drug_assertions.source: compound-database values for roxadustat (EGLN1 IC50 in the nanomolar to micromolar range; thyroid-receptor EC50 in the low nanomolar range), EU product information (seizures common); NOT WWOX EVIDENCE
drug_assertions.measured_result_note: A prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor RAISES HIF: it moves the seeds in the disease direction (a 'mimic'), so it is a direction control for the experiment and not a lever; its own label lists seizures (and secondary hypothyroidism), and a 2025 paper (Morita 2025, passages read) reports thyromimetic action, which is not a label statement; together with brain necrosis in rats this excludes roxadustat itself as a control in a seizure disorder. A prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor without thyromimetic action (molidustat, from that single report) is named in the experiment and is TO BE VERIFIED.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: In WWOX-deficient versus corrected (isogenic) human neural cells: HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein, then whether lowering the axis (genetic HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown, singly and together; a PX-478-class lever) lowers lactate or extracellular acidification, glucose uptake and the five other members of the guard-scope 10-gene glycolysis set reported individually (a change there confirms the seed, it does not validate a lever), and what that does to network activity, viability and SOX2/NEUN fractions; a prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor (a non-thyromimetic one, to be verified) run in both knockout and corrected cells is the direction control. The deciding readout is lactate or extracellular acidification and glucose uptake plus the five genes PGK1, ALDOA, ENO1, PFKP and PKM reported individually; the six IT7 readout genes and the 10-gene glycolysis set they belong to are guard-scope members and cannot decide.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: None in a WWOX-deficient neural cell at the protein level. Non-neural: HIF-1alpha protein up in Wwox-null mouse embryonic fibroblasts (normoxia) with rescue by HIF1A knockdown; in a human fibroblast line cytoplasmic HIF-1alpha is lower in two of four conditions with the nuclear fraction unchanged (different compartment). Human KO organoid: EPAS1 3.80 times, HK2 4.73 times, SLC2A1 2.67 times, HIF1A mRNA flat (transcripts, 4 versus 2 libraries).
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: WWOX-HIF-1alpha protein data are from non-neural cells; organoid data are transcripts of one deposit; the compound statements are cancer-model abstracts; human cells at the week of the phenotype are prenatal-equivalent.

cellular_context.target_expression: HIF1A and ARNT are detected in all adult tissues (HPA, class level); EPAS1 adult brain expression is vascular; HIF protein in WWOX-deficient neural cells is UNKNOWN.
cellular_context.cells_tissue_stage: none measured in WWOX-deficient neural cells at the protein level.
cellular_context.limits: HIF1A mRNA is flat in both human neural systems; the glycolytic transcripts can reflect maturity or composition; transcripts are not flux or HIF activity.

p4_card.identity: A mechanism, not one compound: the HIF axis (HIF-1alpha, HIF-2alpha/EPAS1, ARNT). Genetic knockdown is the primary arm; PX-478 (ChEMBL CHEMBL4117516, free base; salt record CHEMBL4061538; verified by structure; a nitrogen-mustard alert) is one PX-478-class pharmacological arm; a prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor is the direction control (roxadustat is excluded: seizures and thyromimetic action on its label).
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WWOX-DEE only IF a HIF-dependent part of the glycolytic shift exists in WWOX-deficient neural cells and is harmful. The direction of the shift is uncertain, so both outcomes are conditional hypotheses; nothing here is a treatment proposal.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NOT NEW as a pathway (DL-MECH-020 HIF1A to PDK to PDH; digoxin judged the wrong clinical object, N-07). NEW as a generated proposal (IT9 P2 Q2 'opposes' arm, qualified in IT9 P4c-e as KEEP-AS-PROPOSAL, a mechanism experiment).
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: DL-MECH-020, N-07, N-08, HYP-20260709-05 (PDK/DCA, card E03 and I01), card E02 (LDH).
p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN. The experiment decides whether the HIF-dependent shift is adaptive (then lowering it should worsen viability or differentiation) or harmful (then lowering it should improve them).
p4_card.mechanism: Targets: HIF1A (HGNC:4910), EPAS1 (HGNC:3374), ARNT (HGNC:700); direction wanted: lower the axis, only IF the shift is harmful; the HIF target genes SLC2A1, HK2, LDHA, LDHB, BNIP3 and PDK1 are the IT7 readout and may not be used to evaluate any compound (guard IT7_READOUT6).

for: Wwox-null cells show higher HIF-1alpha protein and HIF targets, rescued by HIF1A knockdown (non-neural, normoxia).
The human knockout organoid shows EPAS1 3.80 times, HK2 4.73 times and SLC2A1 2.67 times (transcripts).
against: HIF1A mRNA is flat and HIF-1alpha protein is not measured in any WWOX-deficient neural cell.

A human fibroblast line shows LOWER cytoplasmic HIF-1alpha in two of four conditions with the nuclear fraction unchanged and one blot repetition shown (a different compartment from the nuclear increase in mouse cells: neither confirms nor contradicts it).
The engine edge HIF1A to BNIP3 is review-sourced; the primary record is in non-neural lines.

PX-478 has no activity annotation in the compound database, a nitrogen-mustard alert, only adult phase 1 data and no CNS datum; the HIF axis supports neuronal energy and survival programmes, so lowering it may be harmful.
The organoid glycolytic genes also fall with culture time, so maturity or composition can explain part of the shift (exploratory).
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: No datum from a WWOX-deficient neural cell at the HIF protein or flux level; non-neural cells and cancer models only.

p4_card.pharmacology: PX-478: no activity or mechanism annotation in the compound database; action reported in cancer models; mustard alert; adult intravenous phase 1 only. Roxadustat: HIF-prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor; label: seizures and secondary hypothyroidism; thyromimetic action from a 2025 paper (direction control only). Belzutifan (HIF-2alpha inhibitor) stays INCONCLUSIVE: HIF-2alpha protein in WWOX-deficient neural cells is unmeasured.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

p4_card.predictions: None; no engine, no score. The experiment is proposed, not performed.
p4_card.next_measurement: Discriminating experiment with conditional arms (case record section 7). Step 0: in WWOX-deficient versus corrected human neural cells measure HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein, nuclear and cytoplasmic fractions separately, in normoxia (2D or progenitor cultures as primary) and in hypoxia; organoids at week 8 to 15 have hypoxic cores, so a hypoxia marker co-stain is required. If raised: genetic HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown (singly and together) and a PX-478-class lever against a prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor (non-thyromimetic, TO BE VERIFIED) as the direction control run in BOTH knockout and corrected cells. Deciding readout: lactate or extracellular acidification and glucose uptake plus PGK1, ALDOA, ENO1, PFKP and PKM reported individually (they belong to the guard-scope 10-gene set, so a change there confirms the seed and does not validate a lever); the six IT7 genes cannot decide. Network activity, viability and SOX2/NEUN fractions give the valence (adaptive versus harmful), relative to untreated knockout and to corrected cells; a mixed outcome leaves the valence unresolved. Falsifier: neither HIF protein is higher in the WWOX-deficient neural cells (in the relevant compartment and oxygen condition), or knockdown does not move lactate or glucose uptake.
p4_card.value_added: Puts the HIF axis, the only Q2 item with direct non-neural WWOX support, on one card with its counter-evidence (cytoplasmic HIF-1alpha lower in a human fibroblast line with the nuclear fraction unchanged, flat HIF1A mRNA), the dropped and inconclusive neighbours and the guard that bars the six readout genes from evaluation.
p4_card.clinical_census: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-30 (IT9 P4c-e): PX-478 one study overall (phase 1, adult solid tumours and lymphoma); epilepsy, seizure, hypomyelination, neurodevelopment, WWOX and paediatric terms 0. A zero is no hits for the query string on that date, not proof that no study exists.
